column7: IsPrivateOrLinkLocal (shared SSRF blocklist for dynamic-secrets admin-DSN dials, Azure KMS dials, validateAdminDSNHost) accepted NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96) and IPv4-compatible (::x) IPv6 encodings of private/loopback/IMDS IPv4 (e.g. 64:ff9b::a9fe:a9fe = IMDS 169.254.169.254); To4 folds only IPv4-mapped. Fixed by decoding the embedded IPv4 and checking it (not a wholesale-prefix block, so public NAT64 egress is preserved); found by adversarial probe building the DSN SSRF fuzzer, locked by FuzzIPv4EmbeddingSSRFParity (#1937)
